implementation_decision.reason: Implemented the smallest SDK-owned local score command and schema while preserving existing qwen/risk-mode/scenario dirty work. The command is read-only by default and writes SkillsBar current/history receipts only when --write-current is passed.

receipt_schema_summary.purpose: One local evidence-first receipt for SkillsBar so the UI consumes quality, impact, and security lane evidence without scraping three command outputs.

lane_contract.evidence_usable: Required boolean for every lane. A blocked lane can still be usable when a structured receipt exists.
lane_contract.receipt_path: Required when durable evidence exists; absence_reason required when missing.
lane_contract.command: Required reproducible command string for each lane.
lane_contract.status: pass, blocked, fail, missing, or stale.

receipt_schema_summary.separation_rule: Local Skills SDK score receipts must not be reused as Tessl registry score receipts. Tessl registry scores need a separate schema family.

quality.score: 100 when package verification status is pass/success; 0 when blocked/fail but structured blockers remain evidence_usable=true.
quality.evidence_usable_rule: true when data.skill_package_verification exists and includes status/blockers/agent_summary even if process exit is non-zero.

impact.score: round(100 * promotion_ready_count / scenario_count), or 0 when scenario_count is 0.
impact.evidence_usable_rule: true when the scenario-quality receipt exists with scenario_count, promotion_ready_count, and blocked_count, even if receipt.status is blocked.

security.score: 100 minus severity penalties from detected risk modes: critical=25, high=20, medium=10, low=5, floored at 0. none_detected gives 100.
security.evidence_usable_rule: true when risk-mode taxonomy receipt exists with primary_mode, detected_modes, mode_results, and risk_tier.

local_score_calculation_formula.aggregate: round((quality.score + impact.score + security.score) / 3) when all three lane scores are present. If a lane is missing, compute from usable lane scores and mark score.status=partial with completeness.missing_lanes populated.

partial_blocked_stale_representation.complete: All required lanes are present, fresh, evidence_usable=true, and no lane status is blocked/fail/missing/stale.
partial_blocked_stale_representation.partial: At least one lane is blocked or missing but at least one numeric lane score is evidence-backed.
partial_blocked_stale_representation.blocked: No usable lane score exists, the skill path cannot resolve, or the local-score builder cannot parse the available lane receipts.
partial_blocked_stale_representation.stale: All otherwise usable lane receipts are older than provenance.ttl_seconds or generated_at cannot be trusted.
partial_blocked_stale_representation.freshness: generated_at plus ttl_seconds determines fresh/stale/expired; MVP emits fresh for same-run receipts.

artifact_assertions.assertion: The SkillsBar score feed contract is implemented as a single SDK local-score receipt command with focused schema and command proof.
artifact_assertions.evidence: Implementation evidence records the local-score builder, sdk score command registration, schema-spine fixture coverage, focused tests, and --write-current SkillsBar feed proof.

artifact_assertions.assertion: Scenario-quality already exposes numeric impact evidence independent of process success semantics.
artifact_assertions.evidence: Schema requires scenario_count, promotion_ready_count, blocked_count, blockers, and status.

artifact_assertions.assertion: Risk-mode taxonomy already exposes structured security evidence that can be mapped into a local security score.
artifact_assertions.evidence: Schema requires primary_mode, detected_modes, mode_results, risk_tier, and non-execution safety booleans.

contradictions.problem: Current command lane status can be error while useful structured evidence is still present, so UI score availability must not depend only on process exit code.
Adding a new schema requires editing the schema-spine registry, but that file is already dirty in the current checkout.
